narr: A slow moving thunderstorm led to flash flooding in Bladen County, NC.
ev: Pictures shared via social media show flash flooding in the Clarkton community this evening. Water several inches deep over the road and in a parking lot near US-701 and N Mitchell Ford Rd. Water surrounding a home, yard, and outdoor storage containers at US-701 and W South Railroad Street.
